column5: generate_qtl_sumstats -> qtl_sumstats_construct.R: QtlSumStats for test_study/context1/ENSG00000283047 (200 variants of the gene's cis window, filtered out of the 16-gene TensorQTL nominal table by molecular_trait_id) with the qtl_mini genotypes attached as the ldSketch and summaryStatsQc applied. qtl_rss_fine_mapping -> fine_mapping.R --qtl-sumstats: QtlFineMappingResult from susieR::susie_rss over the same window, --seed 999. Byte-identical across two seeded runs on one machine; the x86/ARM CI matrix may need a looser rtol (in-sample LD from 49 samples is rank-deficient, so the RSS fit is closer to the tolerance edge than the individual-level one).
qtl_rss_twas_weights -> twas_weights.R --qtl-sumstats: TwasWeights from the RSS lasso implementation (lassosumRssWeights) over the same collection, --seed 999. Byte-identical across two seeded runs.
